column1: # FW Conquests season design numbers (#291, CQ-1). Every value is [A] unless its why says [V] or [I].
# The owner decisions Q17-Q21 are open: each choice below is the recommended option, marked [A].
# Season keys ending in _day or _days are whole-day offsets from the season epoch (day 0 = season start).
# Columns and rules: tools/content_conquest.py, docs/content/schema.md. No client data here beyond a few ids.

column5: why

Rolling seasons, one after the other [A]; falsified by the owner choosing fixed calendar seasons or by TQ dates. Owner decisions on the FW Conquests build are open; this is the recommended option, [A].
A season lasts 4 weeks and the next starts at its end [A]; falsified by TQ season dates or an owner ruling.
Path to Conquest runs 21 days of the season [A] (spec 4.1); falsified by TQ dates or an owner ruling.

The siege opens 27 days after the season starts (a whole-day offset from the season epoch, day 0 = season start), so it ends inside the 28-day season before the next one starts [A]; the spec's day 28 would overlap the rollover; falsified by TQ dates or an owner ruling.
The siege window is 3 hours [A] (spec 4.1); falsified by TQ footage or an owner ruling.

The siege system is the one with the most war points [A] (recommended owner option; the spec's alternative was the frontline system of the losing side); falsified by TQ choosing otherwise or an owner ruling.
Only Path to Conquest is served; the Conquest pages stay dormant [A] (recommended owner option); falsified by the owner asking for the Conquest pages.

No client patch to show the dormant Conquest pages [A] (recommended owner option; the pages carry hard-coded numbers and a NameError, spec 1.2); falsified by the owner choosing to patch or by a build that enables the pages.
The item traders serve pilots enlisted in the trader's own militia only [A] (recommended owner option); falsified by TQ traders serving anyone.
Any pilot may shoot a Conquest Engine [A] (recommended owner option; the spec assumed enemy militia only); falsified by TQ refusing neutrals.
A token bought or earned at a trader counts as earned for the nothing-from-nowhere rule [A] (recommended owner option); falsified by an owner ruling that bots may not spend tokens.
An objective's target is 20 times its turn-in recipe's input [A] (spec 4.2, before the econ scale); falsified by TQ card numbers or testers finding it trivial or impossible.
